protocol: The router is data/learned/cp3-router-model.json as exported on 2026-11-03; nothing was retrained or retuned for this evaluation.

The final set's 300 prompts were drawn with their own seed from the same pinned sources after the router was frozen, excluding all 600 suite prompts and the 12 GSM8K pilot questions. The file's SHA-256 was recorded before any model answered it, and every run manifest repeats it.
The paired comparisons and their questions were fixed in code before the final results were read. p-values are Holm-adjusted within each evaluation.
Intervals are 95% percentile-bootstrap intervals over prompts (10,000 resamples, fixed seed). Costs are what the providers billed; free models cost $0.
On the final set the router applies the live catalog saved on 2026-11-13. Mercury 3's 300 calls really failed, which is what the no-catalog rows show.

scenario.title: Observed drift (Nov 12-13)
scenario.description: OpenRouter stopped serving Mercury 3 and cut Gemma 4 26B's price by 12%. The router that is told learns both from the live catalog; with its old estimates it still sends prompts to Mercury, and those calls fail.

scenario.title: Gemma 4 26B costs 30x more
scenario.description: The cheap paid model becomes about as expensive as Gemini 4 Argon.

scenario.title: Gemini 4 Argon costs 4x more
scenario.description: The most expensive model gets dearer. Costs are scored relative to the most expensive model, so this tests whether the router still reacts.

scenario.title: Gemini 4 Argon costs a quarter
scenario.description: The strongest model gets much cheaper.

scenario.title: Free OVHcloud endpoints 3x slower
scenario.description: gpt-oss-120b, Llama 3.3 70B and Qwen 3.8 27B answer three times slower.

scenario.title: Gemma 4 26B 3x slower
scenario.description: The cheap paid model's host slows down threefold.

scenario.title: Free endpoints fail half the time
scenario.description: Half of all calls to the four free remote models fail after 2 s. The tuned settings give reliability no weight, so the router knows the new failure rate but does not avoid the failing models.

scenario.title: Same outage, reliability weighted
scenario.description: The same outage with the user's reliability weight raised from 0 to 1, so a known failure rate counts against a model.

scenario.title: Gemini 4 Argon fails 30% of calls
scenario.description: A partial outage of the strongest model, with reliability weighted at 1.

notes: Outcomes are the stored late-October calls; every scenario rescales them.
